title: Neon Rift Arena
configurationSource: User-provided model label (Anthropic Fable 5.2) and reasoning effort (medium). The model label is normalized as claude-fable-5.2. The actual runtime configuration was not independently available.

validation.syntax: Passed node --check on the single inline classic JavaScript.
validation.structure: Found one title, 1 canvas, 1 inline stylesheet, and one inline classic script. No external assets found in HTML resource attributes or inline CSS.
validation.browser: Passed a smoke test in the Codex browser through a local preview. The Enter Arena screen appeared and gameplay started without console errors.
validation.render: Native WebGL arena, weapon and HUD confirmed visually in a gameplay screenshot.
validation.interactions: Verified mouse capture, weapon selection, firing with ammunition decreasing from 150 to 145, respawning, P pause, and R resetting health, lives, frags and the match timer. Keyboard movement input was exercised.

mobileSupportNotes: Movement, jumping and weapon selection require keyboard controls, with mouse aiming. The source has no on-screen touch controls. Physical phone gameplay was not tested.
